description: This file contains hooks and utility functions for customizing MkDocs documentation build process, including handling translations, file resolution, navigation, and markdown processing.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File, possibly for custom handling of files related to English translations.

methods.name: get_missing_translation_content
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the missing translation markdown file based on the docs directory.

methods.name: get_mkdocs_material_langs
methods.description: Returns a list of available language codes from the material templates directory.

methods.name: on_config
methods.description: Adjusts the MkDocs configuration based on available languages and URL structure.

methods.name: resolve_file
methods.description: Resolves a file path, adding it to the files list, with fallback to an English source directory.

methods.name: resolve_files
methods.description: Resolves multiple files or paths, handling nested structures.

methods.name: on_files
methods.description: Processes the files collection, resolving theme assets and navigation items.

methods.name: generate_renamed_section_items
methods.description: Recursively renames section titles based on the first page title within the section.

methods.name: on_nav
methods.description: Modifies navigation items, applying renaming logic.

methods.name: on_page_markdown
methods.description: Modifies markdown content, especially for translation notices and metadata.
